top_issues: 'How to read this' explainer is 6 lines of green/violet semantics; it burdens a 3-second glance and re-explains the legend directly below.
Legend chips (On-chain/Reserve/Secured/Promised) plus the prose box duplicate the same color message in two places.
Total-balance bar sits above the chips so the green-violet split reads before the meaning is established.
fixes: Collapse 'How to read this' to 2 lines behind a one-tap 'Got it' that fades it out on first visit.
Merge legend chips into one persistent row directly under the bar; keep the prose only in a help affordance.
Move the single-scale note ('Every bar is drawn to one scale') into a tiny footer caption instead of a card.

top_issues: 'send up to 175.00 / receive up to 0.50' helper text is small and the inline bar is very thin, so direction arrows are hard to read on a small phone.
Recent rows mix payment amounts (green) with send amounts (violet) but the two green bars differ in length only slightly, so visual comparison is weak.
fixes: Increase helper-text size to 13sp and give the capacity bar more height (4px) with clearer directional ticks.
Keep the exact one-scale rule but add a subtle 'bar = amount' tooltip on tap so equal widths are comparable at a glance.

top_issues: No total-inclusive amount (amount + fee) is shown near the large Pay button, so the 'you pay 25.00' and 'under 0.01 USDC fee' are not reconciled in one figure.
'Add a note' is low-contrast against the dark background and reads as disabled.
fixes: Add a 'Total 25.00005 USDC' line immediately above the Pay button.
Raise 'Add a note' contrast to the secondary-button style and add a chevron affordance.

top_issues: 'You → H1 → H2' route pills are clear, but the fee comparison between route 1 (0.000050) and route 2 (0.000075) is shown as raw numbers with no per-route 'arrives in' hint.
The selected route card's heavy purple border+fill is a good affordance; the unselected route's lighter fill makes it easy to miss that a cheaper route is available.
fixes: Add a small 'Instantly' vs 'in X s' label to each route option.
Highlight the cheapest route with a 'Best' badge so the better fee is not hidden behind a single selected card.

top_issues: Proof hash '0x59b55173...195c' is truncated with no tap-to-copy on the truncated value, so a verifier cannot grab the full hash.
'Verified by your runtime' is reassuring but 'runtime' is unexplained jargon to a non-technical payee.
fixes: Make the proof hash tappable to reveal/copy the full 66-char value and add a jurisdiction label (Testnet/Depository).
Replace 'your runtime' with 'verified by your node' plus a one-line explainer link.

top_issues: Dimmed underlying screen (Home total $130.00) adds visual noise behind the modal and competes with the receipt amount.
Receipt shows 'Settled 04:41:55 in 9s' but no network/route speed comparison to explain why 9s is good.
fixes: Increase the scrim opacity behind the sheet so only the receipt reads as the active surface.
Add '~9s vs ~1s on-chain' context line under Settled to make the speed claim concrete.

top_issues: '0.50 capacity via H1' is tiny in the top-right and easy to miss — it is the single most important fact for whether this receive will work.
QR sits on a white card that is jarring in the dark theme, though scannable.
fixes: Promote capacity to a full row under the QR: 'Inbound capacity 0.50 USDC — request more to receive larger.'
Keep the white QR card for scan reliability and add a subtle note that it is intentionally high-contrast.

top_issues: 'Send the link or show the code. It opens in any browser with the amount and note filled in' — good, but 'the code' is ambiguous (which code?) for a first-timer.
The 'What is this for?' accordions add friction and read as defensive copy.
fixes: Rename copy to 'Copy payment link — they confirm on their phone' to remove code confusion.
Convert 'What is this for?' into a single info icon with a tooltip instead of an accordion.

top_issues: The bottom '100% collateral / 50% collateral / 0% collateral' buttons are clipped and overlapped by the collapsed action area — a real layout defect on this screen.
'You receive 0.039992' is grayed out and reads like a disabled/errored value rather than a pending quote.
fixes: Give the action area its own scroll/margin so the collateral buttons always clear the primary button.
Use a distinct 'quote pending' style (blue tint + 'quoted' chip) instead of gray for the receive amount.

top_issues: 19 rows of 4-decimal prices and sizes is very dense; on a narrow phone the two columns compress and sizes become hard to scan.
'spread 1.0000 USDC · 0.04%' is good, but there is no visible midpoint or last-trade marker to anchor the book.
fixes: Add a sticky header and a 'last trade' marker, and reduce default rows shown to 8 with 'show all' to ease scan.
Consider a condensed price axis (2,498.5 / 2,500.0) instead of full 4-decimal values to reduce cognitive load.

top_issues: The floating 'Account opening requested with zero credit...' overlay text overlaps the slider/paragraph below and is not dismissible, obscuring the collateral slider.
The bottom 'Swap USDC for WETH' bar overlaps the 'Collateral / New credit' labels.
fixes: Make the toast dismissible with a 'got it' and auto-expire, and reposition it to not cover the slider.
Reserve a fixed footer band so the action button never sits over content labels.

top_issues: The overlay toast text overlaps the paragraph 'The final fee and net amount depend on your account policy...' — text-on-text, a real clipping bug.
'H3 collateral tariff: 0.1 WETH base + 0 WETH gas + 1 bps of collateral requested' is precise but too dense to parse quickly.
fixes: Move the toast above the credit-limit card or convert it into an inline banner that pushes content down.
Collapse the tariff math into '1 bps + 0.1 WETH base' with a 'details' toggle for the full formula.

top_issues: The top legend (secured/promised/you owe/credit room/in flight) is tiny and 'credit room' gray vs 'in flight' slate are hard to distinguish.
'Your credit line to them 115.50 / Their credit line to you 0.00' is easy to misread as 'they owe me 115' when it means you granted them credit.
fixes: Increase legend size and differentiate 'in flight' with a diagonal stripe instead of a gray hue.
Reword to 'Credit you granted H1: 115.50' / 'Credit H1 granted you: 0.00' to remove the who-owes-whom ambiguity.

top_issues: 'Show 2 empty lanes·WETH, USDT' reads awkwardly (middle dot without spacing) and 'empty lanes' is unexplained jargon.
'If you dispute, they answer within 1 d' is good, but there is no inline 'start dispute' action here — it is only on the screen above.
fixes: Reword to 'Add lanes: WETH, USDT' and explain 'lane' once, or replace with 'add assets'.
Add a small 'Dispute' link inline next to the 1-day window so the action is one tap away.

top_issues: The 'Accol' filter tab is visibly truncated (should be 'Accounts') — a real clipping bug that signals poor responsive handling.
'Swap placed 18.58 USDC · open' vs 'Swap closed' is split across two rows without a link tying them together.
fixes: Ensure filter tabs can scroll horizontally or shrink labels so none truncate.
Group a placed-and-closed swap into one entry with an expandable detail, or link 'open' to its close.

top_issues: Proof hash is truncated '0x59b55173...3f195c' with no way to copy the full hash from the receipt.
'Frames 2 committed entries' is ambiguous — a single $25 payment shows 2 frames, which may confuse a non-technical user into thinking two payments occurred.
fixes: Make the proof hash tappable to copy the full value.

top_issues: '1 px = $10' appears twice (top-right and beside the slider) — redundant and slightly confusing about which is the live value.
Toggle labels are long ('Tokens held by your signer on the chain itself. Slow, fully yours.') and push the toggle far from its own heading.
fixes: Keep the single-source value beside the slider and drop the top-right duplicate or make it the only one.
Shorten toggle descriptions to one line and keep the toggle adjacent to its label.

top_issues: 'Reveal recovery phrase' is a high-sensitivity action shown as a routine button with no visible confirm-step or warning styling beyond the text.
'Forget vault' is a destructive red button with no confirmation state shown.
The 'AT THIS SCALE' $10,000 bar overflows its card, which is intentional for the demo but reads as a layout error.
fixes: Convert 'Reveal recovery phrase' into a two-step action (tap, then show 'hold to reveal') with a warning color.
Add a confirm dialog before 'Forget vault' and cap the demo bars at card width with an '…' overflow indicator.

top_issues: The 'Recipient entity · leave empty for yourself' placeholder reads like a required field rather than an optional one.
'Add to batch' is low-contrast and looks disabled.
fixes: Reword placeholder to 'Recipient (optional) — send to yourself if empty'.
Style 'Add to batch' as a secondary button with a visible + icon.

top_issues: The 'What happens: Fund you through H1' circular icon (○) is an undefined glyph — it reads as an empty radio button.
The FROM/TO selector shows identical balances (0.00 / 40.00 / 175.00) in both rows, making the direction of the move hard to verify at a glance.
fixes: Replace the ○ with a clear step number or an arrow-to-circle icon.
Dim the source row and highlight the destination row, or add directional arrows between FROM and TO.

top_issues: The 'Where your money stands' breakdown is excellent but the color legend (green/violet) is not shown here, so the color-coded numbers lose their meaning.
'Yours whatever a hub does $40.00' vs 'Promised by hubs $115.00' is clear, but 'You owe $0.00' is easy to skim past.
fixes: Add the 4-color legend here or show color swatches next to each number in the breakdown.
Bold 'You owe $0.00' so the risk summary reads as a proactive statement.

top_issues: Three tokens all show 0.00 with no balances, making the screen feel empty and giving no sense of what could be here.
'Depository may pull 0.00' is a subtle but important risk line; it is easy to miss because it is dimmer than the token amount.
'Move into reserve' is a small, low-contrast button.
fixes: Add a one-line 'what you can hold here' hint and gray out empty lanes with an 'add' affordance.
Promote 'Depository may pull' and raise 'Move into reserve' to a secondary-button style.

top_issues: 'Permanent limit you grant H1: 115.499973 USDC → 224.949976 USDC' is precise but unreadable at a glance and buries the decision in arithmetic.
Four stacked receive buttons create a very long scroll after the credit-limit block, and 'Receive USDC from H1' is dimmed with no inline reason.
fixes: Round limits to 2 decimals in display and put exact values behind a 'details' toggle.
Add a reason chip next to the dimmed receive action (e.g., 'needs collateral first') and collapse the four actions into a single menu.

top_issues: 'H1 · 3 lanes' uses 'lanes' jargon with no inline explanation.
'= 1.00% per term' is clear but there is no annualized APR for comparison against other venues.
fixes: Add a tooltip for 'lanes' and show '≈ X% APR' next to the per-term rate.

top_issues: 'Offer to the pool' is visibly dimmed/disabled with no explanation of why (e.g., amount is 0.00).
The explanatory paragraph is cut off at the bottom of the screenshot ('...interest come back...'), a truncation issue.
fixes: Add a helper line 'enter an amount to enable' when the offer is disabled.
Ensure the paragraph fully renders with proper bottom padding/min-height so it never clips.

top_issues: 'Self-issued (its id is the hash of its board)' is dense and the 'board'/'threshold' vocabulary is unexplained for non-DAO users.
'Take control of another entity: nothing to take over' is a good empty state but phrased in jargon.
fixes: Add a one-line glossary for 'board'/'quorum'/'threshold' via an info chip, and simplify the parenthetical to 'your identity = your board's hash'.

top_issues: The 'Enforceable right now $40.00' number and legend are excellent; the explanatory prose block is long and easy to skip for a 3-minute reviewer.
'Runtime / Frame / Jurisdiction / Accounts co-signed 1 of 1 / Can dispute without asking 1 of 1' is precise but dense.
fixes: Compress the explanation to 2–3 sentences and move the 'if they vanish, that is the most you can lose' line to a highlighted callout.

top_issues: 'Save evidence bundle' is a large primary action, but the copy directly under it warns 'Keep it off this device' — contradictory placement that undercuts trust.
'nothing at risk · co-signed · proof on file · they answer in 1d, you in 1d' is strong but dense for a quick read.
fixes: Add a 'why it matters' tooltip on 'Save evidence bundle' and move the storage warning to a smaller secondary note.

overall.verdict: The mobile-dark variant is genuinely strong on data legibility and trust — the one-scale risk bars, the 'green is yours, violet is a promise' model, and receipts with proof/frame numbers are a real differentiator. The weakest point is execution: action bars and toasts overlap content on the Swap and Lending flows, and verbose 'how to read this' copy burdens first-timers and mobile users.
priority_fixes: Fix action-bar/overlay content clipping on Swap (05-swap, 05b-swap-cross, 05b-swap-cross-bottom) and Lending (13-lend-bottom): give footers their own scroll/margin so primary buttons never cover labels or sliders.
Compress the home 'How to read this' box to 2 lines behind a one-tap 'Got it' and merge the color legend into one persistent row.
Make proof hashes tappable-to-copy (03, 08) and add a jurisdiction label, so verifiers like Kenji and Ravi can grab full evidence.
Fix truncated text/tabs: 'Accol' tab in Activity (07), overlapped paragraphs in 05b-swap-cross-bottom and 13-lend-bottom — ensure nothing clips on the narrowest phone.
Reduce density on power surfaces (12-assets-bottom, 13-lend) by rounding displayed limits and collapsing tariff/math into a 'details' toggle, surfacing only the decisive figure.

personas.name: Maya
personas.verdict: I could pay my friend 20 dollars pretty fast, but that 'how to read this' box and the green/violet talk made me stop and worry about what's actually safe.
blockers: 'How to read this' 6-line prose on 01-home
credit-line/owed jargon on 06-account
route selection on 02-pay adds a decision

personas.name: Tomasz
personas.verdict: This is the clearest credit-versus-collateral view I've seen — violet promised, green collateral, and the 'nothing at risk' breakdown is exactly what I want in 30 seconds.
blockers: legend 'credit room'/'in flight' colors too similar on 06-account
'Your credit line to them' phrasing risks who-owes-whom confusion

personas.name: Anya
personas.verdict: The book with spread, 1 bps fee, and atomic cross-network settlement is what I'd expect from a serious venue; the swap input screen itself just needs to stop covering its own buttons.
blockers: clipped collateral buttons on 05-swap
'Swap placed / closed' split without per-fill detail on 07-activity
no visible slippage/tick beyond the 1/10000 note

personas.name: Ravi
personas.verdict: The enforce-right-now number, frame hashes, and Export CSV / evidence bundle give me what I'd file with a board — I just need the proof hash to be full and copyable.
blockers: truncated proof hash on 03/08 receipt
no jurisdiction nuance for five- to six-figure sums (Testnet only)
evidence bundle export is a button but no viewer

personas.name: Sofia
personas.verdict: Getting a payment link and a print-ready receipt with proof is great, but it's a receive link, not an invoice with line items and a due date.
blockers: no invoice-specific flow (line items, due date, payer field)
receipt lacks an invoice number

personas.name: Kenji
personas.verdict: The sovereignty screen with co-signed frames, dispute window, and evidence bundle is the kind of audit trail most wallets just don't have.
blockers: no dispute UI shown (only the 'Dispute' button and 1-day window)
proof hash truncated without copy
no bundle viewer

personas.name: Lena
personas.verdict: Paying from my phone is fast and the button is huge, but I have to scroll a lot through 'prepare to receive' and lending screens one-handed.
blockers: long scroll on 12-assets-bottom and 13-lend
'How to read this' box adds an extra tap on home
no one-tap saved-recipient quick pay

personas.name: Marcus
personas.verdict: At a glance I can see exactly what a counterparty owes me, what's collateralized, and what I'd be exposed to if they vanished — that's the desk view I need.
blockers: no aggregated multi-counterparty exposure dashboard
'in flight'/'credit room' colors too subtle
single H1 lane shown, no netting across hubs

personas.name: Fatima
personas.verdict: The cross-network flow shows route, fee, and atomic settlement, but this is crypto-to-crypto — I still can't see it in my local currency or get a per-corridor promise.
blockers: no fiat/local-currency conversion view
fee shown as '1 bps up to 0.0000 WETH' hides real cost
no settlement-time guarantee per corridor

personas.name: Dmitri
personas.verdict: In one screen I get the whole model — green is yours, violet is a promise, enforce right now is $40 — and the one-scale bars make the risk legible. It's genuinely different and it's clear.
blockers: lots of reading; a 3-minute skim may miss the point
'embedded runtime / Depository / Entity' jargon needs a one-line glossary
truncated hashes and 'Testnet' everywhere lower production trust
